major.title: Major incidents
major.subtitle: Command center: roles, timeline, tasks, user and management updates, on-call paging
major.emptyHint: Declare a major incident from an incident card.

declare.title: Declare {{number}} a major incident
declare.directHint: The incident becomes major right away: priority P1, the manager is notified, the command center opens.
declare.requestHint: The declaration goes to a team lead or major incident manager for approval.
declare.reasonHint: Who is affected and why this is a major incident
declare.managerHint: A user with the MIM or LEAD role

fields.publicTitleHint: Shown on the status page and in updates, without internal details
fields.cmdbServices: Depend on the incident CI via CMDB relations

card.notFound: Major incident not found or not available

close.title: Close major incident
close.hint: A post-incident review (PIR) draft is saved from the timeline, roles, updates and tasks. You can finish it after closing.
close.createProblem: Create a problem to find the root cause

updates.title: Updates
updates.subject: Title
updates.usersHint: The update appears in the feed of the major incident and all linked incidents; requesters are notified.
updates.managementHint: The summary is added as an internal note and sent as an event to connected channels.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.placeholder: What happened — it will appear on the timeline

pir.title: Post-incident review
pir.hint: Markdown. The draft is built from the timeline, roles, updates and tasks; add conclusions and actions.

paging.title: On-call paging
paging.groupHint: On-call members are paged; without a shift, the group lead; without a lead, the members
paging.hint: If nobody acknowledges, paging moves to the next step of the chain.

children.title: Linked incidents · {{count}}
children.hint: Requesters of linked incidents receive the major incident updates.

templates.hint: Message templates for users and management. Variables are filled in when a template is chosen.
templates.name: Name

chains.hint: Who to page about a major incident and in what order. Each step waits for acknowledgement.
chains.whoHint: A step is a group or a person. In a group, on-call members are paged; without a shift, the group lead; without a lead, its members.

status.title: Service status
status.allGood: No outages or maintenance right now.
